raw_response:
*Speaking as myself, an old woman farming in Quzhou...*

Aiya, another year. I'm 63 this spring, been working these fields since I married into this village back when I was young. Just me and the old man at home — our son went off to work in the city years ago. He sends some money when he can, but the fields are ours to manage. I can't do what I did at 40, but I know every corner of these 7.5 mu. Knee hurts when I bend, but what can you do.

**My wheat** — I planted it back in October like always, good Shijiazhuang variety seed from the agri-supply shop, 30 jin per mu. Put down one bag of that compound fertilizer (the 15-15-15 kind, 50 kg) on about 3 mu before sowing — that's my rule, one bag for every three mu, same as my mother-in-law did. The wheat is greening up now. In a few weeks when it's properly growing I'll broadcast some urea, maybe half a bag per mu, and give it the spring water from the well. Well water costs now with the meter — each watering is maybe 30-40 yuan per mu for the electricity and pump. I'll water twice — once after I put the urea down, and once at jointing when the stalks start rising. If it rains good I'll skip one. Last year I got about 380 kg per mu, which is not bad for an old lady. Neighbors with more fertilizer got 450-500 but they spend more too.

**My cotton** — I've been cutting back on cotton over the years. Too much picking, my back can't take it like before. This year I'll plant maybe 2 mu of cotton, over on the western plot where the soil is a bit sandy and wheat doesn't do so well. Plant around late April when the soil warms up. I buy the seed from the same dealer every year, the transgenic kind that doesn't need so much spraying for bollworm — thank heaven for that, I remember when we sprayed pesticides every week. Put down a bag of compound fertilizer per 2-3 mu before planting, then topdress urea when it starts flowering. Water once or twice if July is dry. I'll hire my neighbor's daughter and some cousins to help with picking in September-October — pay them by the jin picked, maybe 1.5 yuan per jin. Expect around 220 kg of seed cotton per mu if the weather is decent.

**My maize** — Right after the wheat comes off in June, very quick, only a few days. The tractor driver from the village comes through and we just plant straight into the stubble — no time for proper tillage, never was. Zhengdan-type hybrid seed, whatever the shop has in stock. About 4-5 kg per mu. I put some compound fertilizer in the row at planting and then one topdress of urea when it's knee-high. Summer maize mostly gets by on the rains — if July-August is normal I don't water at all. If it's really dry I'll run the well once. Last year I got maybe 420 kg per mu.

**What I worry about** — fertilizer keeps getting more expensive, and the well water costs add up. Our son wants me to stop farming cotton because it's too much work, but cotton brings in cash at the end of the year when wheat and maize mostly just feed us and the animals. So I keep a little. If things get bad, I can cut back more next year.
